Loss report: gitlab -> concourse
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build trigger.push: workspace from the first triggering resource (the tasks run in the checkout of source-main, and every build uses the newest version of each resource, so a push to source-release builds the newest commit of source-main)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches: one git resource per branch (the job runs once per branch event of the listed branches)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.push: one git resource per branch (the branches main, release are 2 git resources, and the job runs once per branch event)
